Card Q&A.q: I use this card's effect when my opponent's Digimon has no digivolution cards. If that Digimon later gains digivolution cards, can it attack?

Effect: [Main] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack.
Security Effect: [Security] Your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack for the turn.
